description: This file defines a class 'SymbolSet' used to represent sets of character encoding ranges, including predefined sets for Latin-1, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Emoticons, and Dingbats, with functionality to handle collections of ranges.

classes.name: SymbolSet
classes.description: Represents a collection of character ranges for symbol sets, facilitating creation of character encodings with predefined and custom ranges.

methods.name: SymbolSet
methods.description: Initializes a SymbolSet with a collection of range objects defining character ranges.
